title: Customers moved to Credit Hold get a $0 limit and cannot be invoiced
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held only by customer {Customer-A}, with a $500.00 limit, and work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is complete and ready to invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-14 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-14 Hold and {Work-order-1} is S2-15440.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Credit Hold" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Click "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  6. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  7. Open {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." shows.
  • Step 4: a confirmation titled "Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" opens.
  • Step 5: the toast "1 customer moved to Credit Hold." shows.
  • Step 6: the "Credit term" reads Credit Hold and the credit limit reads $0.00.
  • Step 7: no invoice can be created for {Customer-A}: the existing Credit Hold notice shows and Create Invoice is disabled.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S4-E2: “Moving customers to Credit Hold is allowed; from then on no invoice can be created for them until their term changes (existing Credit Hold behavior).”
  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”
  • S4-R16: “On "Set Limits to $0 and Move", each moved customer's credit limit is set to $0 along with the term.”
  • S9-E2: “A customer on Credit Hold is still blocked from invoicing as today; only the Over Credit warning is removed for them.”
